```bash
# DE-RUN
set -Eeuo pipefail

TS="$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)"
EVID="$HOME/Forge-File-Tree-Directories/OP_CONTEXT_M0_CENSUS_${TS}"
mkdir -p "$EVID"

{
  echo "UTC=$TS"
  echo "HOST=$(hostname)"
  echo "USER=$(id -un)"
  echo "HOME=$HOME"
  echo "PWD=$PWD"
  echo
  echo "=== EXECUTION EDGES ==="
  for x in pan de-pan-shell deco-native deco-watch llama-cli llama-server; do
    printf '%s=' "$x"
    command -v "$x" 2>/dev/null || echo NOT_FOUND
  done
  echo
  echo "=== USER SERVICES ==="
  systemctl --user list-unit-files --no-pager 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -Ei '(^|[-_.])(pan|deco|qwen|llama|difference)' || true
  echo
  echo "=== ACTIVE MATCHING SERVICES ==="
  systemctl --user --type=service --state=running --no-pager 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -Ei '(pan|deco|qwen|llama|difference)' || true
} >"$EVID/00_RUNTIME.txt"

find "$HOME" -maxdepth 6 -type d \
  \( -iname '*difference*engine*' -o -iname 'repository' -o -iname '*pan*' -o -iname '*babbage*' \) \
  -not -path '*/.cache/*' \
  -not -path '*/node_modules/*' \
  -print 2>/dev/null \
  | sort -u >"$EVID/01_CANDIDATE_DIRS.txt"

find "$HOME" -maxdepth 8 -type f \
  \( -iname '*OP_PROF*' \
     -o -iname '*OP_REAL*' \
     -o -iname '*operator*profile*' \
     -o -iname '*operator*model*' \
     -o -iname '*operational*reality*' \
     -o -iname '*OP_CONTEXT*' \
     -o -iname '*pan*' \
     -o -iname '*pane*' \
     -o -iname '*projection*' \
     -o -iname '*glossary*' \
     -o -iname '*vocabulary*' \
     -o -iname '*LTCK*' \
     -o -iname '*KRN*' \
     -o -iname '*bootstrap*' \
     -o -iname '*phylactery*' \
     -o -iname '*memory*palace*' \) \
  -not -path '*/.cache/*' \
  -not -path '*/node_modules/*' \
  -print 2>/dev/null \
  | sort -u >"$EVID/02_RELEVANT_FILES.txt"

find "$HOME" -maxdepth 7 -type d -name .git \
  -not -path '*/.cache/*' \
  -print 2>/dev/null \
  | sed 's#/.git$##' \
  | sort -u >"$EVID/03_GIT_ROOTS.txt"

: >"$EVID/04_GIT_STATE.txt"
while IFS= read -r root; do
  [ -n "$root" ] || continue
  {
    echo "=== $root ==="
    git -C "$root" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true
    git -C "$root" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || true
    git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true
    git -C "$root" status --short 2>/dev/null | head -120 || true
    echo
  } >>"$EVID/04_GIT_STATE.txt"
done <"$EVID/03_GIT_ROOTS.txt"

{
  echo "=== SHELL STARTUP PAN REFERENCES ==="
  grep -RniE '\b(pan|de-pan-shell|OP_CONTEXT|LTCK)\b' \
    "$HOME/.bashrc" "$HOME/.profile" "$HOME/.bash_profile" \
    "$HOME/.config" 2>/dev/null \
    | head -200 || true
} >"$EVID/05_STARTUP_REFERENCES.txt"

DIR_COUNT="$(wc -l <"$EVID/01_CANDIDATE_DIRS.txt")"
FILE_COUNT="$(wc -l <"$EVID/02_RELEVANT_FILES.txt")"
GIT_COUNT="$(wc -l <"$EVID/03_GIT_ROOTS.txt")"

echo "STATUS=PASS"
echo "ACTION=M0_LIVE_READ_ONLY_CENSUS"
echo "RESULT=CANDIDATE_DIRS:${DIR_COUNT},RELEVANT_FILES:${FILE_COUNT},GIT_ROOTS:${GIT_COUNT}"
echo "EVIDENCE_PATH=$EVID"
echo "BLOCKER=NONE_AT_CENSUS_EDGE"
echo "NEXT=READ_CENSUS_AND_SELECT_CONTROLLING_REPOSITORY"
```
